basic_info.chief_complaint: Self-complaint of recurring pain in the left upper back tooth, with pain accompanying the face.

oral_examination.oral_examination: 28 Black caries were seen on the maxillary surface, and deep and large caries holes were seen on the distal and proximal surfaces. When probing and percussing, the teeth were not loose and the gums were red and swollen.

diagnosis.primary: 28Treatment plan for acute pulpitis (K04.001) 28Extraction is recommended.

source_handle: 28 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine was used to divide the gingiva, increase the gap, and loosen the gums. They were pulled out by pulling and compressing to stop bleeding.
